subject: POC intake: Boreal health — traffic validation & milestone runbook
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@boreal.health>, Ethan Morales <ethan.morales@boreal.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: POC intake: Boreal health — traffic validation & milestone runbook

Hi Alyssa / Ethan —

Great meeting today, thanks for walking us through your inference use cases. Per promise, here’s a concise recap and the proposed next steps to lock in the trial window. I’ve attached a quick success-metrics workbook and a sample curl that reproduces one of your request shapes.

High-level summary of what we heard you need for the POC:
- Primary feature: anonymized clinical note summarization (batch + streaming variants)
- Target latency SLO: median <= 200 ms for 95% of live requests
- Typical token lengths: 600–1,200 input tokens, summaries ~80–200 tokens
- Concurrency target: steady 30 concurrent streams; burst up to 200 RPS for 2–5 minutes during morning sync jobs
- Expected test volume: 500k tokens/day during evaluation week (scaled traffic pattern attached)

Immediate ask from our side:
1) Confirm the 2-week POC window you mentioned (proposed start: 2027-09-13)
2) Send any SSO/KMS constraints or a short security checklist (we can fast-track RBAC/KMS guidance)
3) Confirm whether test data will be uploaded into a VPC-only bucket or sent over our hosted API

Proposed POC milestones (draft):
- Week 0 (prep): credentials, network readme, baseline traffic sample ingestion
- Week 1 (ramp): ingest replay traffic; validate latency and KV-cache behavior
- Week 2 (stress & acceptance): run sustained burst scenarios, evaluate cost profile + quality metrics

Owners: Redwood - Logan (sales, PM cadence), Marissa (solutions engineer), Dev (runtime tuning). Boreal - Alyssa (product owner), Ethan (platform).

Next steps: Please confirm start date and whether you can share a 24-hour compressed traffic sample (anonymized) by EOD Friday, 2027-09-03. I’ll ping Marissa and Dev to block time for an initial runbook sync after you confirm.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
(650) 555-0123

Attachments: boreal-poc-success-metrics.xlsx (spreadsheet), sample-traffic-curl.txt (request sample)
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@boreal.health>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ethan Morales <ethan.morales@boreal.health>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC intake: Boreal health — traffic validation & milestone runbook

Thanks Logan — this looks good and aligns with our discussion. Quick clarifications: 

- Start date: 2027-09-13 works for us.
- Data path: for the POC we prefer to use your hosted API behind a restricted API key; we will not share raw PHI. We will scrub and anonymize notes before sending.
- Security: I’ll have our security ops fill out your short checklist — expect that early next week.

Traffic sample: I can share a 24‑hour compressed sample (anonymized) by Friday EOD as requested. It will include: request timestamps, input token counts, and a small set of example payloads.

One more ask: can Redwood provide a simple acceptance rubric for summarization quality (ROUGE-ish metrics or manual review counts) so our clinical reviewers can sign off?

—Alyssa
Product Lead, Boreal Health

On Thu, Sep 2, 2027 at 08:05 Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks again for the call — attaching the same workbook in case it helps.
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@boreal.health>, Ethan Morales <ethan.morales@boreal.health>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC intake: Boreal health — traffic validation & milestone runbook

Looping in a few technical clarifications so we can size capacity and recommend a quantization profile: 

Logan / Alyssa — quick Qs for the traffic sample you plan to send:
- Average request size distribution: can you provide a histogram or a handful of percentiles (p50/p90/p99) for input token counts?
- Burst cadence: are the morning sync bursts predictable (daily @08:00) or ad-hoc depending on business events?
- Real-time vs batch split: what % of traffic needs streaming low-latency responses vs asynchronous batch?

From an infra side, our initial recommendation is to test with a 16GB KV cache profile and mixed-int8 quantization; that should hit your latency SLO for the token ranges above but we’ll confirm after a dry run.

Dev — can you prepare a lightweight runbook to execute the compressed sample with:
- replay tool command (curl variants + tokenization flags)
- monitoring checklist (latency p50/p95/p99, token throughput, GPU mem pressure)

I’ll draft the acceptance rubric for summarization quality — propose a 50-sample blind review with pass threshold 85% clinician agreement plus automated ROUGE-L median >= 0.45 as a starting point. Thoughts?

—Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@boreal.health>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2027 08:31:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC intake: Boreal health — traffic validation & milestone runbook

Thanks — I’ve attached a short runbook and a sample replay command (sample-traffic-curl.txt). Summary of what I’ll run for Week 1: 

- Baseline pass: replay 24h compressed sample at 1x speed to validate functional behavior and initial latency profile
- Ramp: increase replay speed to 3x while keeping concurrency target at 30 streams for 30 minutes to check KV cache warm-up behavior
- Burst test: synthetic bursts up to 200 RPS for 5 minutes, repeated 3x with 10 minute cool-downs

Monitoring metrics I’ll capture: p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, GPU utilization, memory headroom, and request error rate. I’ll push logs to the shared Drive folder and post links.

Attachments: runbook-run-20270903.pdf, sample-traffic-curl.txt

—Dev
Runtime Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@boreal.health>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>

- Acceptance rubric: the proposed blind review + ROUGE-L median threshold looks good; we’ll add a short clinical priority mapping to the workbook before upload

Next meeting: Monday 2027-09-06 at 10:00 PT for runbook handoff and API key exchange. Please send calendar invite.

—Alyssa
